what: The crate's `// alloc:` comments, its `#![blaze::sans_io]` and `std_use` were never held to their lints: blaze building blaze needs more memory than the lane's 128 GB VM (A25), so `blaze check` was not run on the tree; cargo checks none of them.
cause: no VM of 256 GB in this lane
workaround: cargo with the pinned nightly, as blaze-builds-blaze says
fix: the main agent's one `blaze check` of the tip
class: vacuous success (A39), neighbour: tests or lints that never compiled or never ran, counted as held
